text.p: Tropical cyclone Gavin continues to strengthen. This system is rapidly becoming a very dangerous cyclone. Top winds are now 130 mph with the system located just south of the Tuvalu islands in the southwest Pacific. Top winds may reach 140-145 mph in 24 hours as the storm heads southward toward the Fiji Islands, approaching the eastern Fiji Islands. This system will be an extreme risk to shipping and boating in the region over the next 24-48 hours. The Fiji islands will come under the risk for wind and flood damage in about 36 hours.
